messages:
ria: hey folks — heads-up from Nimbus SI: their Azure Marketplace test for customer 'Acme Labs' hit a blocker on private deployment. image boots but app process dies with network errors, customer can't complete handoff. deploy-bot shows 502/gateway error. can @jordan or @mike take a look?

jordan: on it. is this just their staging tenant or any marketplace test?

ria: staging only so far, but partner reports they tried two different subnets and saw same behavior. attaching the small snippet they pasted:```
ERROR: failed to fetch metadata: dial tcp 169.254.169.254:80: i/o timeout
WARN: 502 upstream response
panic: kvcache: inconsistent map size (expected 4096, got 0)
```

mike: :eyes: quick thoughts — metadata timeouts -> imds access blocked (Azure IMDS). that will break image init hooks that fetch instance config. also kvcache panic looks like runtime crash after config bootstrap fails. can someone confirm if the customer VNet blocks IMDS or uses custom route table/NVA?

sana: cc eng-platform — if IMDS is blocked we should allow fallback to our boot config stored in the image (we have that toggle). we can also flip the rollout to the previous image for that customer while SI troubleshoots. quick command:```
# rollback to last stable image
redwoodctl rollout rollback --deployment acme-labs-private --to-image redwood-inference:v2026-04-12
```

ria: i just asked Nimbus to try rollback and to check NSG/NAT rules. they tried the curl to metadata and got timeout. doing the rollback now. customer reported partial restore but still seeing occasional kvcache panic when load increases. they said they hit it after a cold start where many inits happen in parallel.

alex-p: sounds like an init race coupled with metadata unavailability. propose a short architecture check-in with Nimbus + Acme infra team to validate:
- IMDS reachability/IMDS v2 settings
- outbound SNAT port saturation from NAT gateway
- custom init hooks that call external services (batch them or add retry)
- enable our fallback boot config and canary to 5%
I can join tomorrow 09:30 PT. is that okay? :thumbsup:

jordan: also recommend we enable temporary routing fallback in Console so requests go to hosted model if private fails — reduces customer impact while SI fixes. i'll open an ops ticket and add the rollout policy change.

deploy-bot: rollback started for deployment acme-labs-private at 1843154380 — status: in_progress

ria: thanks all. i'll coordinate the architecture call and post notes here. Nimbus asked if we can share a short checklist of common infra gotchas for marketplace/private images — can someone paste that checklist before the call?

sana: i'll drop the checklist in this thread before 08:00 PT tomorrow. going to triage the kvcache stack with runtime folks now.

alex-p: thanks — i'll confirm meeting and invite SI + Acme infra.
